title: Pair decoding recovers the input encoding
statement: Let $x$ be a binary string and let $c$ be a dimension together with an algebraic circuit of that dimension. If decoding the first component of the pair parser’s total projections of $x$ returns $c$, then $x$ is the self-delimiting encoding of those two projections.
hypotheses_covered: The decoded first projection of $x$ equals $c$
